title: No UNIQUE constraint on (chat_id, sender_msg_id) in messages table
description: The messages_sender_msg_id index is CREATE INDEX (non-unique). The idempotency guarantee is enforced only by application logic (SELECT then INSERT under Mutex). If the Mutex discipline ever changes or the error-swallow bug (P0-1) fires, the DB provides no independent safety net and will silently accept duplicate (chat_id, sender_msg_id) rows. Should be CREATE UNIQUE INDEX.
